claims.claim: Non-Performing Assets (NPAs), are loans or advances for which the principal or interest payment remained overdue for a period of 90 days or more.
claims.note: The RBI defines an NPA as a loan or advance where interest and/or installment of principal remains overdue for more than 90 days.

claims.claim: The RBI mandates minimum CAR requirements for all commercial banks to ensure stability of the financial system.
claims.note: The RBI mandates a minimum Capital to Risk-weighted Assets (CRAR) of 9% for commercial banks in India.

claims.claim: In India, the Reserve Bank of India mandates a minimum of 9% for commercial banks.
claims.note: The Reserve Bank of India mandates a minimum Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of 9% for commercial banks.
